text:
maya: Quick heads-up — planning a small surge deploy tomorrow 03:00 UTC, ~15m window. Need a quick rollback playcheck and smoke owners. Who's around? :wave:

oliver: i'll be deploying. can do 03:00 UTC. which services?

maya: runtime API and caching layer (runtime-v2 + kv-cache). low risk but affects p99 for short bursts.

jess: I'll own smoke tests. What are the acceptance criteria?

maya: basic sanity: 200 on /health, token throughput at baseline, no error spike >1% for 10m. Full list: https://docs.internal/redwood/deploys/smoke-checklist

samir: oncall: @sre-oncall — can you stand by for 03:00-03:30? Also rollback runbook is at https://wiki.internal/redwood/runbooks/rollback-playbook. Use the `rd-deploy rollback` CLI. Quick rollback steps below.

sre-oncall: i'm available. i'll monitor tailing logs and latency graphs.

oliver: deploy steps: push tag -> run canary (5%) -> wait 10m -> promote. If canary errors, rollback.

release-bot: canary scheduled: 03:05 UTC canary 5% -> auto-promote at 03:15 if green.

maya: rollback criteria: 1) canary 5% error >1.5% sustained 3m OR 2) p99 latency > 2x baseline 5m OR 3) rollback requested by SRE/QA/product.

jess: noted. i'll run the smoke script after canary promote. ping me when canary starts.

samir: quick rollback commands:

```
# rollback to previous good tag
rd-deploy rollback --service runtime --to-tag v2026.03.10
rd-deploy status --watch
```

also have DB-migration: none for this deploy.

oliver: if rollback needed I will run the above and then run `rd-cache flush --service kv-cache --grace 30s`

maya: agreed. owners: oliver (deploy), jess (smoke), samir/sre-oncall (monitor + rollback), maya (coord). Everyone ack?

jess: ack :white_check_mark:

oliver: ack

sre-oncall: ack

release-bot: note: outage window recorded 03:00-03:30 UTC. Postmortem template pre-filled.

maya: thanks. I'll post a short runbook snippet in #eng-releases 30m before. Keep phones nearby, especially sched oncall. :phone:
